layoutBasis.slotSpan: next direct field native offset, or native size tail for final field
layoutBasis.recursiveBoundary: Only direct fields are recovered; embedded value types, references, and generic arguments are not expanded.

unresolved: Nested value-type layouts are retained as direct field type boundaries and are not recursively expanded.
Reference and generic fields are retained as opaque direct-field boundaries; no ownership or element access is claimed.
Burst Execute/UnsafeDo, solver numerics, scheduling, and transform writeback remain unrecovered.
